title: Endoscopic Submucosal Dissection for Early GI Neoplasia in the United Kingdom
official: Endoscopic Submucosal Dissection in the Treatment of Early Gastrointestinal Neoplasia: A UK Cohort Study to Assess Effectiveness and Safety
summary: Multicentre cohort study on the use of endoscopic submucosal dissection for the treatment of early gastrointestinal neoplasia.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or Female, aged 18 years or above undergoing endoscopic submucosal dissection
* Participant is able to give informed consent for participation in the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients under the age of 18
* Patients unable to give informed consent
